_about: The home prototypes (proto-home, 2 Nov 2026; hide and seek, pick it up and put it back, the clean-up: build/reports/designs/hide-and-seek.md, pick-it-up-put-it-back.md, clean-up-day.md): the words and lines the three games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry (pos from `pos` where given, else a noun) and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.
